ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across >90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixel distribution is limited to discrete, localized spots and linear markings, creating a high-contrast sparse-to-dense ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous dark-field background across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped as follows: high-density solid clusters at distal tips; circular 'O-shaped' ring formations scattered in the medial regions; and thin linear filaments predominantly in the left-medial and right-medial quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a measured pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees; notch depth extends approximately 18% into the fluke's vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, stochastic serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge. Sharp vertical pixel offsets (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced at the outer thirds of both lobes, appearing as irregular jagged interruptions to the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning to a convex outward sweep; terminal ends of the lobes exhibit an upward-tapering geometric trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct circular and annular high-intensity pixel groups (rosettes) distributed across the lower-medial and mid-lateral surfaces of both lobes. Dense, multi-pixel white clusters are concentrated on the extreme distal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned high-contrast linear disruptions; specifically, a prominent near-vertical line in the left lobe and several short, multi-directional diagonal scratches scattered across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme peripheral erosion/irregularity along the trailing edge; heavy white encrustations or calcified-pixel clusters at the distal tips; multiple circular and linear impact-type scars across the ventral plane.
